name: VMware Certified Implementation Expert - Network Virtualization
name_ja: VMware認定実装エキスパート（ネットワーク仮想化／NSX）

logistics.format: Awarded after passing both VCAP-NV Design and VCAP-NV Deploy proctored exams (Pearson VUE)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded advanced design/deployment pathway and five-year profile support expert virtual-network implementation, with microsegmentation relevant to defense; NSX dependence limits broader architecture portability.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Advanced design and deployment exams plus hands-on assessment support expert network-virtualization implementation. Microsegmentation adds security relevance, while NSX concentration limits portability to other network platforms.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded design and deploy practical requirements establish substantial network-virtualization delivery, including relevant microsegmentation work. The five-year profile and product-specific scope support professional rather than broad expert placement.
